body: 0212 is a state-and-mechanization entry of the ever-forward mode: the RH solution object (RHEnd Part B21.3, rh_program78_stripfront_mach_unifiedArvi_PT2 : RH q) is a COMPLETE machine-checked reduction gated on exactly (i) the [Z78ArviDensity] external quasi-RH input (theta = 43693617/50000000 = 0.87387234, board best), (ii) the zero-set condition + certified on-line data records (below 14.14 and below tPT2 = 3,000,175,332,800), and (iii) the single named terminal face hOffCPT2 (no off-pair in t0 >= tPT2, 0 < d0 <= 0.37387234). The structural fact restated in-tree (Z78ArviDensity.zetaZeroStripArvi + offPairD0leArvi): the external input yields CONTAINMENT - every off-line zero must sit in 0 < d0 <= arviD0max = theta - 1/2 = 0.37387234 - while the EXCLUSION inside that strip interior is the terminal face itself; arviD0max moves to 0 exactly when the board theta reaches 1/2, and every merged board record below the current face shrinks the face (the B6 mechanism, demonstrated seven times: 0131/0133, 0142, 0162, 0195, 0200, 0203, 0211). (3) Collet paper provenance re-confirmed ABSENT (the named non-blocking TODO stands): the tracker-cited URL haileystorm.github.io/research/finite-ordinary-source-moments/ still 404s; the QRH-Catalogue (HaileyStorm/QRH-Catalogue, all 8 base-data shards + components.jsonl + annotations.json pulled and grepped) carries NO public-paper / public_artifact record for 'ordinary source moments' (her other papers - cycle25-quartic, single-prime-29-33 - DO appear as public artifacts, so the gap is record-specific); the PR #69 submission tree (in the 0211 frozen replay repo) contains metadata.json + src only, no .tex manuscript.
